defender.name: courier

reward_parameters.engagement_window: native direct bomb rays + native contact; no chains; distinct center cells
reward_parameters.engagement_state: training World.engagement_paid bool[2], fresh/reset clears; not observed or checkpointed
reward_parameters.approach_target: walkable cell-center bomb seed reaching frozen opponent native contact cells with native direct range/occlusion
reward_parameters.approach_counterfactual: same pre-step wall/brick/bomb and opponent for before/after own cell
reward_parameters.pressure_timing: actual saved fuse; own floor((fuse-2)*native_speed)-2 cells, enemy ceil(fuse*native_speed)+1 cells, bounded32
reward_parameters.pressure_counterfactual: same pre-step wall/brick/existing bombs/enemy; compare reachable safe endpoints without vs with only this actual owned bomb
reward_parameters.pressure_existing_blast_avoidance: all pre-existing direct rays and current linger avoided for entire escape path; board frozen
reward_parameters.pressure_state: training World.pressure_paid bool[2]; once per seat/game, collector reset only; no observation/checkpoint ABI change
reward_parameters.approach_v11_temporary_bombs: not long-horizon path disconnections; native masks and urgent danger still gate actual movement
reward_parameters.approach_v11_field: weighted four-neighbor planning paths to exact native direct-attack seed cells; convergence <=195 passes; unreachable2048
reward_parameters.approach_v11_subcell: minimum same-field neighboring cell-center distance + native actual subcell L1 offset; no per-tick contact/idle bonus
reward_parameters.approach_v11_danger_gate: no shaping when pre/post position has native pre-board danger>=.5 or current blast linger
reward_parameters.sustained_pressure_candidate: exact V10 legal owned native-contact placement, conservative timed endpoint reduction and predicted own escape; no chain/simultaneous new other bomb
reward_parameters.sustained_pressure_state: training-only pressure_count int32[2], pressure_next_tick int32[2]; retained across phase/death/respawn; reset only full game; actor/observation/checkpoint tensor ABI unchanged
reward_parameters.pursuit_v13_field: V11 weighted subcell path to exact native attack seeds using planning-only max(1,int(native power)-1); permanent walls hard, bricks cost6, temporary bombs excluded from path-disconnection only as V11
reward_parameters.pursuit_v13_plateau: zero potential inside native reduced-range contact window, same frozen pre-board/opponent for own before/after; no idle/occupancy/entry bonus
reward_parameters.pursuit_v13_danger_action_role_masks: exact V11 real own legal movement, both transport alive empty actionable, urgent danger/linger gate, no forced slide

defender.reward_wiring: V13 exact V12 rules/transport/kill/safety/pressure: replace V11 approach target by planning-only native attack range margin one cell (minimum1); zero potential throughout exact frozen native margin window; .02 signed progress and original danger/legal/role gates; physical range and all other reward unchanged
